units.source_text: 聆听他讲述的我，好不容易才松了口气。

en.t: As I listened to him speak, I finally managed to breathe a sigh of relief.

units.source_text: 一种强烈的感动向我袭来，

en.t: A powerful emotion swept over me,

units.source_text: 我没能从接触到过去连想都没想过的思考方法所感到的痛苦中苏醒过来。

en.t: and I could not awaken from the pain I felt at coming into contact with a way of thinking I had never even imagined before.

units.source_text: 柏木话毕，"啊"地吐了口气。

en.t: When Kashiwagi finished speaking, he let out a breath with an ah.

units.source_text: 春天的阳光洒满了我的周围，我清醒过来了。

en.t: Spring sunlight filled the space around me, and I came back to myself.

units.source_text: 明媚的三叶草儿熠熠生辉。

en.t: The bright clover glittered in the light.

units.source_text: 从后面的篮球场传来的喧嚣也复苏了。

en.t: The noise from the basketball court behind us came back to life as well.

units.source_text: 然而，我觉得所有这一切虽发生在同一个春天的晌午时分，却仿佛整个改变了意义表现出来。

en.t: And yet, although all of this was happening in the same spring noontime, it seemed to me that everything had appeared with its meaning completely changed.
